svg.title: The first and second overtones of a string
svg.desc: Left: the first overtone, with two loops and a node in the middle; its wavelength is λ2 = L and its frequency f2 = v_w/L = 2f1. Right: the second overtone, with three loops and two interior nodes; λ3 = 2L/3 and f3 = 3v_w/2L = 3f1. Arrows point to the interior nodes.
